digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center transport / reconciler TicketTransport port
propositions: A writing reconcile pass on the DC transport fails because twelve transport members the core reaches for are absent from JiraDataCenterTransport and undeclared on any Protocol in _backend.py.

The dominant failure mode is silent degradation, not crashing: seven members are swallowed at every call site and three are mixed, so the pass appears to converge while not syncing comments, links, parents, or properties.

Each of the twelve absent members must receive a recorded verdict (IMPLEMENT via DC REST v2, NotImplementedError naming the limitation, or unreachable-by-call-site) backed by call-site evidence rather than symmetry with Cloud.

set_reporter requires implementing issue.update(fields={'reporter':{'name':...}}) plus fixing inbound_fields._identity_of to carry DC's name into account_id, otherwise the reporter mutation re-emits on every pass and idempotence fails.

TicketTransport lacks @runtime_checkable so isinstance raises TypeError; it must be made runtime_checkable, declare the required members, and be asserted at backend construction, backed by a structural test collecting every attribute access on client/transport receivers.

Newly-implemented transport members must log failures at WARNING naming the member and remote id via a module-level logger, since transport.py currently has no logging and swallowed members surface nothing.
